title: c3-output-schema-capability-probe
description: MINIMAL self-contained probe schema used ONLY to empirically measure what codex `--output-schema` enforces. NOT the real C3 report schema (that is Step 4's c3-codex-response.schema.json). Two capabilities under test: (1) top-level additionalProperties:false — does codex drop/reject a top-level field the model was told to add? (2) one if/then rule — does codex honor a JSON-Schema conditional (verdict==fail => reason required)?

reason.description: Conditionally required by the if/then rule when verdict==fail.
